name: MGA-New Park (Grupo MGA)
note: Spanish group of gaming halls, bowling centres and casinos headquartered in Cerdanyola del Vallès (Barcelona); its Golden Park brand covers the group's gaming rooms and its online casinos in Spain and Portugal. Crónica Global (9 Sep 2025) reports it belongs in equal parts to the companies Reflektor and Corporesa, owned by Joan and Enric Sanahuja Amat, heirs of founder Jaime Sanahuja Junyent.
